definition: Too slight or gradual to be noticed.
author: H. G. Wells
quote: All the old constellations had gone from the sky, however: that slow movement which is imperceptible in a hundred human lifetimes, had long since rearranged them in unfamiliar groupings.
example_sentence: The change in her mood was almost imperceptible.
